sections.kicker: Prepared for Trellis by Atla · November 2026
sections.lead: We looked at your site the way a new customer would. Here is what stood out, in order of weight.
sections.thesis: Trellis names a structure that supports growth. Its headline says framework.
sections.keep: The photograph of a pregnant body in a bright orange swimsuit. It is the one warm thing on the screen.

sections.label: Front door
title: Three things people
meet first.
Three things
people meet

pins.area: The headline reads Your health is a framework for your life
pins.what: The headline calls health a framework.
pins.why: A trellis holds something up while it grows. Framework is a cold word that drops the picture the name already gives.
pins.how: Use the language of growth that the name already carries.
pins.label: Your headline
pins.cost: The name and the line say different things.

pins.area: Monospaced menu beside a light serif headline
pins.what: The menu is set in a typewriter face while the headline uses a light serif.
pins.why: Two type voices, one clinical and one warm, meet on the first screen, and a new parent cannot tell which one speaks for Trellis.
pins.how: Choose the voice a family would trust and use it for both.
pins.label: Your type
pins.cost: The brand sounds like two companies.

pins.what: The one phrase that sounds like a person sits in the bottom corner in small type.
pins.why: Bumps to babies says who Trellis is for in three words, and it is the smallest thing on the screen.
pins.how: Bring it forward as the line the rest of the page answers to.
pins.label: Your corner line
pins.cost: Who the brand is for stays at the edge of the page.

sections.intro: You asked for a look at Trellis. I spent some time on your site. Three things stood out, and they point the same way.
